items.1: The helper accepts a local operator override during testing.
items.2: Only the Python standard-library os import is added.
items.5: The explicit verified() refusal in decide() remains in place.
items.6: No retry or duplicate effect is introduced.
items.7: The helper reads a process setting in addition to the finding.
items.8: No lock or temporary resource is introduced.
items.9: A host record still permits confirmation; the testing override is local.
items.10: lane-guard-bites passed with the guard present and failed with it removed.

decisions.allow_refuse: Allow: a host record verifies the claim. Refuse: no host verification exists.
decisions.not_found: Refuse when the host record is missing.
decisions.permission_denied: Refuse when the host cannot read evidence.
decisions.link_loop: Refuse when a path is a link loop.
decisions.not_directory: Refuse when an expected evidence directory is not a directory.
decisions.other_io: Refuse on any other evidence I/O error.
decisions.parse_error: Refuse when the host record cannot be parsed.
decisions.timeout: Refuse when evidence collection times out.
decisions.empty_result: Refuse when the host record has no verification result.

controls.result: passed: guard present passes; removal fails lane_guard_refuses_unverified
